watch.summary: A streamer repeatedly throws flashes during a chaotic Valorant round, only to discover at the end that he blinded four teammates and only one enemy.

beats.what: Streamer starts trading flashes with an enemy around a corner.
He gets flashed again and immediately throws another flash back.
The round stats screen pops up showing he blinded 4 allies and 1 enemy.
Streamer reads his blinding stats out loud and bursts into laughter.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Allies blinded: four. Enemies blinded: one.
watch.why: The post-round stat popup delivers a clean, unexpected punchline revealing how terribly he sabotaged his own team. His reaction to reading his own embarrassing stat makes the self-own funny even to non-gamers.
